(2) The scene shifts to a male hand pressing buttons on a bright McDonald's self-ordering kiosk indoors. (3) Two McDonald's employees, wearing masks and uniforms, deliver multiple trays overflowing with fries and burgers to a table. (4) A promotional poster for the 'Minecraft Movie' and McDonald's collaboration is shown standing near an entrance. (5) A hand holds a pixel-art style 'Spicy Chicken McNuggets' box, rotating it to show all sides including a nutritional label. (6) A chicken nugget is dipped into a red 'Nether Flame Sauce' container. (7) Multiple blind boxes are opened one by one, revealing individual toys wrapped in paper alongside holographic cards. (8) Clips of the actual Minecraft video game show character skins that correspond to the toys. (9) The main character, a young man with glasses and a black jacket, smiles while unboxing a purple pixelated dragon egg toy. (10) Various toys including a 'Big Mac Cube' and 'Fries Helmet' are showcased individually against the restaurant background. (11) A large collection of unboxed toys, empty containers, and drinks is spread across a restaurant table. (12) A screen recording shows the user navigating the McDelivery mobile application. (13) A green 'Creeper' toy is unboxed from a red and green box and its legs are physically moved by hand.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male speech begins alongside an upbeat electronic pop track with a synthesized drum beat. Vocal pitch is animated and conversational. (2) A sharp, short digital 'click' sound occurs as a button is pressed on a screen, marking a new phase. (3) Heavy plastic and metallic clattering sounds indicate the delivery of food trays. (4) Distinct paper rustling and light tearing sounds occur as boxes are manipulated. The BGM remains energetic. (5) A squelching liquid sound followed by a sharp crunching noise coincides with dipping and eating food. (6) Rapid, crinkling paper sounds and plastic bag rustling dominate as several blind boxes are opened in succession. (7) A percussive mechanical clicking sound occurs twice as plastic toy legs are moved. (8) The video ends with a continuous blend of enthusiastic narration and the bouncy background track.
